violations.description: Preventing contamination of packaged and unpackaged food. — --Raw animal food was not properly separated from raw or cooked ready-to-eat food. -A 1 pound tube of raw sausage is thawing in the same cambro as ready-to-eat Canadian bacon.

Clean-in-place (CIP) equipment - Design and construction. — --Nonfood contact surface of clean in place equipment was not cleaned properly. -Found a build up of food product under the cutting board of the dessert prep table. Advise cleaning under the cutting board more frequently.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Ventilation hood system was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. -There is a build-up of grease over the burger press. The entire hood system should be cleaned.

Single-service and single-use articles. — --Single-service item was reused or used more than one time. -A single use portion cup without a handle is being used to scoop marinara sauce at the pizza prep table.
Cleaning and maintenance of floors, walls and ceilings. — --Physical facilities (e.g. floors, walls, ceiling etc…) were not maintained in good repair. -Back room floor is peeling up around the drain.
